rows.b: Microfinance, particularly through Self-Help Groups (SHGs), offers small, collateral-free loans that enable women to start businesses, improve their homes, and gain economic independence, while also fostering savings habits, community participation, and leadership roles. However, challenges such as over-indebtedness, high interest rates, social barriers, and low financial literacy persist, limiting full access to banking services due to cultural norms and restricted mobility (YOGANANDHAM & VARALAKSHMI 2026).
